zh.siteTagline: 步数 · 健走 · 跑步 · 骑行
zh.heroTitle: 智能运动助手，健康生活每一天
zh.heroDesc: 小树运动是你的专属运动教练。智能天气建议、GPS 轨迹记录、年度挑战激励，支持健走、跑步、骑行，实时心率监测，数据同步健康应用。
zh.downloadCta: 在 iOS App Store 中搜索「小树运动」下载
zh.featuresSubtitle: 专业运动记录与健康管理
zh.featureStepsDesc: 实时统计每日步数，助你达成 10000 步目标，数据自动同步至 Apple 健康。
zh.featureModesDesc: 支持健走、跑步、骑车三种模式，专业计时与配速，实时显示距离、时长、速度。
zh.featureGPSDesc: 实时记录运动轨迹，计算准确距离，运动路线一目了然。
zh.featureWeatherDesc: 根据天气状况提供个性化运动建议，适合户外运动的时间推荐，炎热防中暑、寒冷防感冒。
zh.featureLiveDesc: 运动状态实时显示在锁屏界面，无需解锁即可查看进度。
zh.featureHealthDesc: 与 Apple Health 完美同步，运动分析、目标设定、智能提醒，数据永不丢失。
zh.aboutDesc: 小树运动致力于让每个人都能科学、轻松地坚持运动。通过智能天气、轨迹记录与健康数据整合，陪伴你的每一步健康生活。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用提供的运动建议仅供参考，请根据自身身体状况合理安排运动强度。

en.heroTitle: Your Smart Fitness Coach, Every Day
en.heroDesc: Treelet Fit is your personal fitness coach. Smart weather suggestions, GPS tracking, annual challenges, walking, running, and cycling with real-time heart rate and Health app sync.
en.downloadCta: Search "Treelet Fit" in the iOS App Store to download
en.featuresSubtitle: Professional activity tracking and health integration
en.featureStepsDesc: Real-time daily step count toward your 10,000-step goal, with automatic sync to Apple Health.
en.featureModesDesc: Walking, running, and cycling with professional timing and pace; distance, duration, and speed at a glance.
en.featureGPSDesc: Record your route in real time with accurate distance calculation.
en.featureWeatherDesc: Personalized suggestions based on weather; best times for outdoor exercise; heat and cold reminders.
en.featureLiveDesc: See your workout progress on the Lock Screen without unlocking your device.
en.featureHealthDesc: Full sync with Apple Health: analysis, goals, and reminders; your data stays secure.
en.aboutDesc: Treelet Fit helps everyone stay active in a simple, science-backed way. With smart weather, GPS tracking, and Health integration, we’re with you every step of the way.
en.disclaimerText: Fitness suggestions in this app are for reference only. Please exercise according to your own condition.
